campaign.title: M1 lower far-alias incomplete-fibre dispersion gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary-source literature may be used only for exact additive-twist, Voronoi, exponent-pair, divisor, or spacing theorems. Record the theorem statement, parameter dictionary, coefficient class, smoothing, endpoint uniformity, absolute-value placement, and resulting R-power before treating a source as applicable.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact Round-140 far height-alias scalar be bounded at R X^epsilon by signed cancellation in its incomplete divisor coefficient across near-radical and nonsquare phase cells; if not, what is the first exact phase-cell, hyperbola, divisor-pairing, additive-twist, source-hypothesis, self-return, circularity, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X=y^2+q, 0<=q<=2y, and fix 0<rho<1/8. Put L_h=floor(rho y/sqrt(h)), D_h=y-L_h-1, and let r_h be the least positive odd integer at least 4Nh/D_h^2. The exact grouped far coefficient is A_rho(m)=sum_(h|m, r=m/h odd, r>=r_h+2)chi_4(r). The frozen scalar is T_N=sum_(m>=1)m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)A_rho(m)e(sqrt(Nm)), effectively m<<N/R^2 asymp y, and the exact target is |T_N|<<_epsilon X^epsilon uniformly for every real X.
quantities: The far mask is height-dependent and integer. Any simplification to r>2sqrt(m), a half-divisor sum, or the complete r_2(m)/4 coefficient must carry an exact target-safe correction.
The known divisor upper bound and h=1 plateau show matching R^(1/2) excess in the grouped weighted sum before the outer N^(1/4) factor; modulus is not a proof.
Exact radicals m=Dt^2 for N=Du^2 are target-safe, but near radicals and nonsquare phase cells have no accepted estimate.
The phase sqrt(Nhr) is rank one and the second canonical transform returns the reciprocal phase. A claimed gain must be noninvertible or use actual signed arithmetic.
Same-sign supported prime-square fibres and character-correct fourth-power rays rule out automatic fibrewise cancellation, but are not scalar lower bounds.
The coefficient is a discontinuous divisor-incidence sequence. Any one-dimensional derivative theorem must prove the required coefficient variation or additive partial-sum hypothesis.
Round 140 supplies unsquared scalar equivalence only. No positive energy, centre average, residual deletion, downstream theorem, or exponent change may substitute for the fixed-centre scalar target.

completion_criteria: Derive an exact disjoint phase-cell or near-radical decomposition with every integer, floor, mask, profile, endpoint, and multiplicity retained.
Prove the nonresonant complement target-safe before isolating a smaller resonant survivor, or give a complete target estimate for the original scalar.
Audit the exact arithmetic of A_rho(m), including divisor switching, parity, complete-fibre comparison, prime-power controls, and any additive partial sums used.
For every cited theorem, verify the coefficient class, smoothness, length, frequency, uniformity, and full R-power ledger against the exact scalar.
Test exact and near radicals, odd fourth powers, q=0 and q=2y, small and top m ranges, and the self-return under any second transform.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_near_resonance_reduction, or incomplete_fibre_dispersion_no_go.
Make no lower-GAR, direct blockwise M1, M9-M1, M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion unless every corresponding owner closes.

review_seams.requirement: The height-dependent divisor mask, parity, floors, profiles, and complete-fibre comparison are exact and no correction is silently discarded.
Every exact or near resonance has a defined integer parameter, width, multiplicity, endpoint convention, and weighted capacity.
Any strict survivor is licensed only after the entire complement is proved at X^epsilon with the actual coefficient.
Every imported theorem matches the exact coefficient, smoothing, fixed-centre range, uniformity, and absolute-value placement, with a complete R-power ledger.
A transform, full-divisor replacement, or radial theorem is checked for inversion, uncontrolled complements, and dependence on the desired circle estimate.
Only the grouped far scalar or a proved strict survivor may change; every square-level, downstream, and exponent claim requires its separate owner.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact Round-140 far scalar is target-equivalent to the floor-free cone r>4h after exact and microscopic nearest-square cells |k_m^2-Nm|<=sqrt M are removed at target cost. The remaining nonresonant cone has singleton phase cells and full coefficient-blind excess; exact divisor pairing self-returns or is blind, the coefficient has a linear quarter-frequency mode, and every audited source estimate remains polynomially above target or has the wrong coefficient or direction.
